step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates Shopline's e-commerce platform integration with an acquired POS system. Key elements include: 1) Authentication and API access where POS Client authenticates against an ECS SSO gateway (using OpenID) and POS Admin invokes API Gateway (Open API), protected by AWS WAF and AWS Shield. 2) Data synchronization flow between Couchbase (POS DB) and MongoDB (Internal Shopline DB) via Kafka and an ECS Proxy worker. 3) Top-level data lake storage/monitoring using CloudWatch and S3 for analytics.

graph.name: Shopline POS Integration Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture showing Shopline's e-commerce platform integration with a POS system, including authentication via ECS SSO and API Gateway, and bidirectional database synchronization between Couchbase and MongoDB using Kafka and an ECS Proxy worker.

edges.notes: Couchbase sends synchronization updates to Kafka streaming service
Kafka streams updates to ECS Proxy worker
ECS Proxy worker pushes platform changes back to Kafka
Kafka synchronizes platform updates into Couchbase
POS Client authenticates against ECS SSO Gateway via OpenID protocol
ECS SSO Gateway returns authentication tokens to POS Client
POS Admin invokes Open API endpoints hosted on API Gateway
AWS WAF filters web traffic protecting API Gateway
AWS Shield provides DDoS protection for API Gateway
